what: Chart A under Q.5 (lower half of printed p191): renin-angiotensin flow chart; INPUT 'Decreased arterial pressure in kidney' branching left (JGA signal to afferent arterioles, vasodilation of efferent arterioles, increased glomerular blood flow and pressure) and right (JGA secretes renin, empty box, angiotensin I to angiotensin II, empty box); OUTPUT 'Increases blood volume and blood Na+ level' over a third empty box; RETURN TO HOMEOSTASIS 'Restoration of normal blood pressure' at the top. Page is the 0-based whole-book PDF index of p-200.png.

Diagram B (top left of printed p192): coloured nephron with glomerulus (red) in Bowman's capsule, convoluted tubules, loop of Henle and collecting duct, a dark line across it marking the cortex/medulla boundary, about five blank pointer lines, no printed labels. Page is the 0-based whole-book PDF index of p-201.png.

Diagram C (top right of printed p192): black line drawing of a Bowman's capsule cup with the glomerular tuft inside and podocyte-like cells on its walls, continuing below as a tube of cells with nuclei; no labels or pointers. Page is the 0-based whole-book PDF index of p-201.png.

Chart D (middle of printed p192): ADH flow chart; INPUT 'Low water concentration in blood detected by osmoreceptors in hypothalamus' to ADH release, an empty box, facultative water reabsorption; INPUT 'Na+ transported from proximal convoluted tubules into blood' to higher peritubular osmotic pressure and high water concentration; both into OUTPUT 'High water concentration in blood', which points to 'Inhibits secretion of _____' and to RETURN TO HOMEOSTASIS 'Restoration of normal water concentration in blood'. Page is the 0-based whole-book PDF index of p-201.png.

Picture E (bottom left of printed p192): haemodialysis set-up, a patient's forearm joined by a tubing loop to a cylindrical dialyser, with three pressure gauges, a roller pump, a syringe (heparin) and flow arrows; no labels. Page is the 0-based whole-book PDF index of p-201.png.
